candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored owner.
Return the caller (msg.sender) instead of the stored owner.
Return the reward distributor address instead of the stored owner.
Return the migrator address instead of the stored owner.
Delete the require check so the zero address is accepted as a new owner, allowing renounce-like zero ownership via transferOwnership.
Transfer ownership to address(0) instead of the given newOwner, so owner() after the call differs from the original.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership so any caller can set the owner, changing the observable owner after a non-owner call.
Delete the _checkOwner() call in the onlyOwner modifier so guarded functions like transferOwnership can be invoked by any caller, altering the resulting owner state.
Remove the assignment to rewardDistributor, so the state variable never changes.
Assign msg.sender instead of the _distributor parameter.
Assign the zero address instead of the _distributor parameter.
Remove the _checkOwner() call so anyone (not just the owner) can call setRewardDistributor and change rewardDistributor to an arbitrary address.
Set migrator to msg.sender instead of the provided _distributor parameter.
Set migrator to the zero address instead of the provided parameter.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can change the migrator.
Delete the _checkOwner() call inside onlyOwner so the ownership guard no longer reverts for non-owners.
